decisions.reason: The message reiterates the existing self-service workflow for editing and exporting future customer reports but does not change its current requirements.
The required DX17–DX20 final PDF exports are already fully captured by the candidate's message 74 INTRODUCE Event.
Selecting Canva as the template format does not alter the existing set of customer-specific editable fields or their editability standard.
The candidate already has a message 74 MODIFY Event capturing the expanded package of fonts, icons, logos, colour codes, and other necessary design assets.
Requesting Canva templates and PDF exports after noting that only Word files were delivered adds missing formats; it does not remove or modify the delivered Word format.
The candidate already requires editable DX17, DX18, DX19, and DX20 variants; message 74 does not change the variant set or its risk-based selection rule.
The delivery-format decision does not alter the scoring-summary table, its fields, or its presentation requirements.
The message's approval language does not change the risk-appropriate narrative wording, and cross-requirement propagation must not add implementation or verification status.
Providing the reports as Canva templates and PDFs does not change the required front-page result drivers, bullet format, or detail level.
The source decision does not change the vehicle identifier content or its clean non-checkbox presentation.
The Canva and PDF delivery requirements do not alter the front-page result fields, heading, prominence, spacing, or visibility.
The requested delivery formats and assets do not change the internal-page header coverage, presentation, or text.
